messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Observability ingestion degraded — Datadog reports delayed/queued ingestion in us-east-1. Key SLO graphs missing recent points. Pager engaged.

zara (oncall): I'm seeing a hard gap on the error-rate dashboard from ~2026-10-05T11:34Z. Can people confirm scope (metrics/logs/traces)? :rotating_light: 

leo (sre): metrics and logs affected. Traces intermittent. Example: `avg:service.error_rate{env:prod}.rollup(avg,60)` shows zeros for multiple hosts since 11:33Z. Alerts are firing but no new points in Datadog.

hana (infra): Datadog status indicates "ingestion delay" in US-EAST. Opened support ticket DD-10012, escalated to SE. Status link: https://status.datadoghq.com/incidents/DD-10012 (pasted).

zara (oncall): ok. I'll coordinate. @leo please take monitoring lead. @marta handle customer comms. I'll manage vendor escalation and PD handoff if needed.

leo (sre): on it. Immediate mitigations: 1) mute Datadog alert noise 2) flip critical dashboards to Prometheus fallback 3) enable buffered log export to our S3 bucket for critical services 4) enable temporary trace export to object storage for active investigations. Doing commands now.

leo (sre): mute command:```bash
./ops/alertctl mute --source datadog --reason "ingest_delay_us-east" --ttl 2700
```

leo (sre): enable prometheus fallback toggle:```bash
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://ops.internal/featureflags/fallback_prometheus -d '{"enabled":true}'
```

marta (support): drafting banner + enterprise messages. Draft preview: "We're experiencing delayed observability data due to a third-party provider incident. Your application appears to be operating normally; dashboards/alerts may be delayed. We've enabled fallbacks and are investigating. We'll provide updates every 20 minutes." Thoughts? :speech_balloon: 

hana (infra): deploying S3 trace exporter canary for api-gateway and payment-service. Manifest snippet:```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: trace-exporter-temp
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: exporter
        image: registry/redwood/trace-exporter:ephemeral
        env:
        - name: S3_BUCKET
          value: redwood-temp-traces
        - name: SAMPLE_RATE
          value: "0.15"
```

leo (sre): tailing our datadog-forwarder logs — seeing rate limits and 503s:```bash
[11:35:12] WARN forwarder: retrying batch, status=429
[11:36:01] ERROR forwarder: upstream 503 Service Unavailable
```

incident-bot: Datadog status update - "Investigating ingestion backlog in us-east. Engineers working on pipeline. No ETA." :information_source: 

zara (oncall): contact with Datadog SE initiated. Please attach forwarder logs + example query timestamps. Also start suppressing datadog alerts to avoid duplicate paging.

marta (support): identified 5 enterprise customers with active alerts referencing missing telemetry. Starting proactive outreach; will prioritize payments/fraud customers. Drafted message and scheduled sends.

leo (sre): added a quick watchdog script to detect backfill spikes: compares the distribution of timestamps from Datadog vs Prometheus fallback. If Datadog shows sudden historic ingestion (backfill) we keep dd alerts muted until verification. Script snippet:```python
# quick detector: if dd_backfill_spike > threshold -> keep muted
# compare latest_ts_dd vs latest_ts_prom
```

hana (infra): increased local log buffer limit for critical pods and enabled log ship retry to s3:```bash
./ops/logship --buffer /var/log/tmpbuf --dest s3://redwood-temp-logs --retry 15
```

marta (support): posted Intercom banner and updated support queue note: "Observability degraded — using fallbacks and exporting traces to object storage for investigations." Support reactions already: :thumbsup: :thinking_face:.

datadog-status-bot: Update 11:48Z - some streams are showing partial backfill. Engineers are processing backlog; ETA unknown.

leo (sre): note — to avoid alert storms when Datadog backfills, we'll keep dd-alerts muted and rely on fallback alerts (Prometheus) as the source of truth until SE confirms backfill complete.

zara (oncall): agreed. We'll only unmute after explicit confirmation from Datadog AND our watchdog shows no re-ingest spike in 30m. Update cadence: 20m.

marta (support): sent targeted messages to the five flagged customers. One replied saying their billing alert didn't fire — escalated to eng with S3 trace link.

hana (infra): canary exporter healthy. Sampling at 15% to conserve bandwidth. Verified traces landing in s3 with prefix `s3://redwood-temp-traces/2026-10-05/`.

leo (sre): Datadog SE asked for a list of critical metric names and last-seen timestamps; provided `service.latency`, `service.error_rate`, `payment.success_rate` with sample logs and forwarder errors. Ticket DD-10012 updated.

datadog-status-bot: Update 12:02Z - backlog processing progressing; partial metric backfill observed. Logs may take longer.

zara (oncall): important: document any windows where alerts may have failed (false negatives) for the postmortem and customer timeline. @leo please capture exact gaps and which alert rules could be impacted.

leo (sre): capturing gap windows and mapping to alert rules now. Also adding a short-run mitigation to run synthetic canaries: emit test metrics every 60s to both Datadog and Prometheus fallback to detect divergence. Command:```bash
while true; do curl -sS -X POST https://metrics.internal/emit -d 'name=synthetic.ingest.check&value=1'; sleep 60; done &
```

marta (support): update to customers: "We are seeing partial restoration of metrics; logs and traces may remain delayed. We'll continue to provide updates." Some customers asked for expected backfill time; relayed Datadog's "no ETA" response.

hana (infra): FYI — one customer reported missed payment alert which we triaged using the S3 traces + fallback metrics. Confirmed there was an alert condition in Prometheus and we took manual action to unblock charge flow. Notified the customer.

incident-bot: Reminder — add incident classification tag: third-party-observability and update PD ticket.

zara (oncall): PD updated. Assigning follow-ups: leo -> telemetry verification + watchdog, hana -> exporter + buffering, marta -> customer comms + ticket log.

datadog-status-bot: Update 12:24Z - backfill ongoing; majority of metrics processed, logs still catching up. Engineers expect staggered replay.

leo (sre): seeing catch-up on core metrics at 12:27Z. There's a brief re-ingest spike which confirms backfill in-progress. We're keeping dd alerts muted until Datadog confirms final replay.

marta (support): informed customers about catch-up behavior and that we'll adjust communications after final confirmation. Offering targeted help to any customer with operational impact.

hana (infra): post-incident TODOs noted: 1) formalize multi-backend fallback for critical alerts 2) automate unmute guard tied to backfill detector 3) add persistent S3 trace exporter toggle for on-call activation 4) review vendor SLA for replay/backfill obligations.

zara (oncall): thanks team. We'll keep this incident open until Datadog confirms final backfill and our watchdog shows stable timestamps for 30m. After closure I will run the blameless postmortem template and include customer-impact timeline.

incident-bot: Next scheduled update in 20 minutes.

marta (support): final quick note for timeline: contacted 5 customers, 1 had missed alert leading to manual mitigation (payments) — documented for credits discussion.

leo (sre): logging final mitigation summary to incident tracker: Prometheus fallback enabled, DD alerts muted, S3 trace exporter canary, increased buffering & logship to S3, synthetic ingest canary started, vendor ticket open (DD-10012).

zara (oncall): closing remarks for now: coordinated vendor escalation, mitigations prevented widespread customer impact, follow-ups created. Good work. :clap:
